title: Every chart ships a paired text-alternative table with the same data, focus-reachable in the same landmark
asA: screen-reader user using the shipped surface
iWant: every chart to ship a text-alternative table carrying the same data as the chart, in the same landmark, cell-per-value, focus-reachable
soThat: the chart's information is available in a form assistive tech traverses cell-by-cell (WCAG 1.1.1 the shelf inherits through TAC-1901)

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a rendered chart, a `<table>` element carrying the same data lives in the same landmark (`role="region"` wrapping both the chart and the table, or the same `<section>` element), with a row per x-axis value or category and a column per series (cell-per-value contract). The table is either visible under the chart or visually-hidden and focus-reachable through a labelled control the shell renders (a `<button>` or a skip link). Assistive tech traverses the table cell-by-cell and every cell text matches the corresponding chart value. Probed by the application-charts pack check AC-18103-1 (Playwright drives to the route, reads the accessibility tree, asserts the table is present in the chart's landmark and the cell texts match the chart's rendered values).
acceptanceCriteria.then: a `<table>` in the same landmark carries the same values cell-by-cell and is focus-reachable

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a rendered chart whose text-alternative table is visually-hidden, the shell renders a labelled control (a `<button>` or an anchor link) that moves focus to the table's first cell; the control's accessible name reads `Show data table` or an equivalent operator-configured label. The control is keyboard-reachable in reading order before the chart's own interactive controls.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a rendered chart with a visually-hidden text-alternative table
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator tabs into the chart's landmark
acceptanceCriteria.then: a labelled control appears before the chart's data-point controls and moves focus to the table on activation

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a rendered chart, when the pack inspects each cell of the paired text-alternative `<table>`, every cell's text value matches the chart's rendered value for the same (x, series) coordinate to the same precision the chart renders; a mismatched or missing cell fails the pack check.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a rendered chart and its paired text-alternative table
acceptanceCriteria.then: every cell's text value matches the chart's rendered value for the same (x, series) coordinate; mismatch or missing cell fails

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a rendered chart whose paired `<table>` is missing from the same landmark (the `<table>` renders in an unrelated section, or under a different `role="region"`), the pack fails the check per REQ-003; a passing chart has both the chart and the table under the same landmark element (a shared `role="region"` or the same `<section>`).
acceptanceCriteria.given: a rendered chart whose paired table is outside the chart's landmark
acceptanceCriteria.when: the pack inspects the landmark boundaries
acceptanceCriteria.then: the check fails; a passing chart has both chart and table inside the same landmark

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a rendered chart whose text-alternative table is visually-hidden with `display: none` (making it inert for assistive tech), the pack fails the check; a passing visually-hidden table uses a technique that keeps the table in the accessibility tree (`clip-path` or the `sr-only` pattern with `position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden`) so screen readers can reach the cells.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a rendered chart whose text-alternative table is hidden with display:none
acceptanceCriteria.when: the pack inspects the accessibility tree
acceptanceCriteria.then: the check fails; a passing hidden table uses a technique that keeps the cells in the accessibility tree
